description: This file defines the main Home page component for a simple notes application built with LightningJS. It manages layout, state, note persistence in localStorage, and handles user interactions such as creating, selecting, editing, and deleting notes.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: Main LightningJS component representing the home page of the notes app, including layout, state management, and event handling.

methods.name: sortedNotes
methods.description: Sorts notes in descending order based on their updated timestamp.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Persists the current list of notes to localStorage.

methods.name: $onSelect
methods.description: Handler for selecting a note by id.

methods.name: $onCreate
methods.description: Handler for creating a new note and setting it as active.

methods.name: $onSave
methods.description: Handler for saving updates to a note.

methods.name: $onDelete
methods.description: Handler for deleting the currently selected note.

methods.name: $onSearch
methods.description: Handler for updating the search query used to filter notes.
